annotations.text:
LANDING - one language at a time, switched in the header.
Khmer is the default (matches readStoredLocale in App.tsx). The toggle always offers the OTHER language: the Khmer page shows the UK flag + English, the English page shows the Cambodian flag + Khmer.

Nine sections in both: Hero, Problem, Solution, How It Works, Dashboard, Pricing, Features, Why KCMS, Final CTA.

Khmer strings taken from copy.ts where they already exist (severity labels, target labels, coverage list, sample comments). The rest I drafted - worth a native read before it ships.

Pricing: Free $0, Pro $- marked coming soon, Business custom. No invented prices.

SYSTEM
N1 teal rail on the sidebar, K2 figures with sparklines, T2 underline tabs, I1 pill search, C2 shadow cards.

R3 tinted queue rows, with one adjustment: rows that need nothing stay neutral grey, so a full queue is not a wall of colour. Only comments awaiting a decision carry a tint.

Moderate collapses the sidebar to a 72px rail so the queue and the review sheet both get room.

ADMIN
A 3px ink rule across the top and a sidebar one step deeper in grey than the tenant's white one — the privileged surface stays obvious without going dark.

Built around the access-request flow already in AdminRequestsPage.tsx, plus the operational panels it is missing: system health, platform totals, audit.

Foundations (right) carries the locked palette, the DM Sans + Noto Sans Khmer ramp, your component picks, and the eight named motions with live demos.
